description: Zwerg Magier / Spellwarp Sniper (Lv. 13). Fokus-Armbrust der Zielsuchung (+2 Seeking Distance Light Crossbow), +3 Twilight Mithral Shirt, Headband of Intellect +6, Cloak of Resistance +4, Ring of Protection +2, Amulet of Natural Armor +1, Metamagic Rods & Tränke.
